summary: The accepted fountain helper advances this case to a TTY message-state mismatch at segment 0 step 140. C replaces the answered dry-up prompt when the nymph removes a blindfold; JS appends the new theft message to the stale prompt and reaches More before the next source message. The owner is topl.c:update_topl, which B currently reserves.

source.branch: C update_topl() appends only when ttyDisplay->toplin is TOPLINE_NEED_MORE or WIN_STOP is set. Otherwise it replaces gt.toplines with the new message. JS update_topl() treats every state except TOPLINE_NON_EMPTY as a pending message, so TOPLINE_EMPTY also reuses _pending_message. The answered fountain dry-up prompt is cleared to TOPLINE_EMPTY by cmd.js:finishCommandParse; the next pline therefore appends it. The prefix takes room needed by do_wear.c:off_msg's 'You were wearing a blindfold.' message, moving the More boundary and following theft/sight messages.
callers: C fountain.c:dipfountain -> dryup -> cmd.c:y_n/yn_function -> topl.c:tty_yn_function; the turn then reaches steal.c:steal and do_wear.c:Blindf_off/off_msg.

JS fountain.js:dipfountain -> dryup -> cmd.js:y_n/yn_function -> topl.js:tty_yn_function; cmd.js:finishCommandParse clears the answered prompt before tty_message.js:ttyPlineCore calls topl.js:update_topl for the nymph theft messages.

The water nymph stole a blindfold.--More--', and step 142 'The water nymph vanishes!'. The exact JS replay shows the old 'Dry up fountain?
